summary_en: ¥1.0 billion upper limit; 1,100,000 shares (2.09% of ex-treasury S/O); open-market purchase (投資一任方式); execution window Aug 10 2026–Mar 31 2027. Rationale: responsive capital policy, shareholder return, capital-efficiency enhancement.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Own Shares
translation_en_brief: Sintokogio's board of directors resolved on August 7, 2026 to acquire up to 1,100,000 shares of its own common stock, representing 2.09% of shares outstanding (ex-treasury), within a budget ceiling of ¥1.0 billion. Execution will run from August 10, 2026 through March 31, 2027 via open-market purchase (投資一任方式, a mandated investment method). The company stated the acquisition is intended to support responsive capital policy, return value to shareholders, and improve capital efficiency in response to changing business conditions. As of June 30, 2026, 52,516,173 shares were outstanding (ex-treasury) and the company held 2,064,755 treasury shares.
